Mitsawokett: A 17th Century Native American Community in Central Delaware

Preserved Primary Document • HarmonEdwardRevWar.htm

Edward Harmon, Revolutionary War pensioner

Contributed by Michael Cannon bookeeah@yahoo.com Oct 4, 2010

I found some Revolutionary War information for Edward Harmon (b abt 1758 – 19 Jun 1834) who I believe to be Native American. He married Agnes Jackson (b abt 1770 – death unknown) on 27 Nov 1788. On the last page of his pension file it list his children as Benjamin Harmon (b abt 1795 – death unknown), Garrison (spelled Derrickson in the file) Harmon (b abt 1797 – death unknown), Paynter Harmon (b abt 1799 – death unknown), Woolsey Harmon (b abt 1808 – death unknown), and Eliza Harmon (b abt 1810 – death unknown). Attached are the 1800, 1810, 1820, marriage listing, revolutionary war pension application, revolutionary war roll, and revolutionary war pension payment list.
